description: Machine-readable session intent for agent and runtime context. Values describe the declared driver and requested posture; they do not grant launch, mutation, save, or runtime authority.

drivenBy.description: Declared session driver; context only, never an authority grant.

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier. Formatted as YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS or a UUID.

sprint.description: Declared active sprint or certification context.

priorityEngineMode.description: Requested engine posture only; active workflow and bounded-execution authority remain mandatory.

autoLoopEnabled.description: Requested auto-loop state; does not authorize execution.

commitSha.description: Git commit SHA at session start.
